function.name: musicCharts_getMostPlayed
function.description: This function retrieves the most played song in a particular genre from a specified region Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

genre.description: Music genre e.g., Rock, Pop, HipHop etc.

region.description: Region where the song popularity is to be checked

duration.description: Time duration in hours for which the music played count will be considered. default is 0

message.reasoning:
The user asks: "目前最受歡迎的流行歌曲是什麼？還請幫我找出澳洲目前最受歡迎的搖滾歌曲。" They want the most popular pop song currently (no region specified) and also the most popular rock song in Australia. We need to use the function musicCharts_getMostPlayed. For the first request, we can call with genre="Pop" and region unspecified? The function requires region. Maybe we can set region to "global" or "world". But the function signature requires region: string. So we need to provide a region. If not specified, maybe we can use "global" or "world". But the user didn't specify region for the pop song. We could interpret as global. So we call with genre="Pop", region="global". For the second request, genre="Rock", region="Australia". Also duration optional. We'll just use default.

We need to call the function twice. Then respond with the results. Use the function calls.
